metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: DOYQEP crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C79 H139 Gd5 N2 O42 P6,5(C1 H4 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd4 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd5 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 3 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.887-3.940 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 105.64-108.92°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd5(μ3-OH)(NO3)2(dipp)6(MeOH)7(H2O)4]·5MeOH (dipp = 2,6-diisopropylphenylphosphate). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
